component.name: PanePilot
component.summary: Two-panel file manager inspired by FreeCommander
Zwei-Fenster-Dateimanager nach dem Vorbild von FreeCommander

description.p: PanePilot is a free two-panel file manager for Linux, inspired by FreeCommander. It combines tools that usually require several separate programs in one application.

ul.li: Two panels with folder tree, nested favourites and a drive overview
Search by file name and content
Multi-rename with placeholders, counters, dates, regular expressions, preview and undo
Meta wizard for music tags with covers, converters, CSV import and export, playlists and ReplayGain
Checksums with comparison and drag and drop of checksum files
Configurable keyboard shortcuts, function-key bar and toolbar

description.p: Packaging: AppStream metadata and an English desktop entry for software centers and AppImageHub.
